GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Passing the 600m was taken wider. When questioned regarding the disappointing performance of the gelding, rider advised that his mount over-raced in the early stages and got its head up and consequently was unable to finish off its race but also may have come to the end of its preparation. Co-trainer advised that the gelding would now be sent for a spell.
